{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.820
    | text      = So here's where we'll start with Alex asking Busey about the New World Order.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.860
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:21.820
    | text      = Gary, from your study of the New World Order, because I'd like to get your angle on it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.779
    | text      = what do you think about this global system?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.620
    | text      = Oh, I think it's primitive in many ways.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:31.580
    | text      = I had a trip to the other...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.940
    | text      = I think it's primitive in many ways, simply because the experience I had December 4th, 1988.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.379
    | text      = I went off to Harley Davidson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:41.659
    | text      = It begins.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:42.460
    | text      = Without a helmet, I hit head first and butt first into a curve.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.179
    | text      = Split my skull and put a hole in it that big, my skull, and I had massive brain surgery.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:53.899
    | text      = Cedars-Sinai, 1-15.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.139
    | text      = PM, Sunday afternoon, December 4th, by Dr. Lauren Houghton.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:00.299
    | text      = And he told me if I'd been three minutes late, I wouldn't be here now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.860
    | text      = So it's all in the quickness to get the victim to the hospital.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.460
    | text      = I came out of the hospital in recovery from a traumatic brain injury where I had to learn
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.899
    | text      = to walk, talk, eat, dress myself, organize, speak all over again from the very beginning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.779
    | text      = And I went to Washington and met with a George H. Bush administration, White House briefing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:25.659
    | text      = talk about how the federal government should look into acting in support and favor for people with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:32.220
    | text      = traumatic brain injuries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:33.820
    | text      = And I'm the advocate and the creator of the Traumatic Brain Injury Act that Bill Clinton
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.139
    | text      = signed into an act in 1996.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.899
    | text      = I have a first and last page of the Traumatic Brain Injury Act from this White House stationary
}}
